pairs.subject: review-iteration-loops
pairs.evidence: src/app/app/[projectId]/studio/obsahovy-engine/page.tsx:43 The content engine module mounts the creation surface where generation iteration re-runs full prompts instead of executing an edit plan with minimal operations over reviewed drafts.

techniques.evidence: src/components/ai/useAiTool.ts:266 Iteration re-runs the entire generation prompt with the steering note appended rather than outputting a minimal list of edit operations (retime, rewrite, cut, insert) over reviewed drafts.
src/components/ai/primitives.tsx:423 Feedback accepts unstructured free text in RefineBar rather than mapping review notes to a typed taxonomy of focus, scope, and order.
src/components/ai/ArticleDraftPanel.tsx:384 Regeneration invalidates and clears pinned imagery instead of keeping approved sections by reference and preserving structural seams.
src/components/ai/useAiTool.ts:211 Non-satisfiable review notes trigger generic errors rather than first-class refusal responses carrying explicit reasons and unchanged lists.
src/components/ai/ArticleDraftPanel.tsx:469 The interface provides a single unanchored regenerate button rather than generating a divergent candidate slate anchored to named references.
src/components/ai/ContentBriefGenerator.tsx:769 Steering notes entered via RefineBar bypass the structured scope parameters without precedence rules or collision routing.
src/components/ai/useAiTool.ts:238 Generations are serialized into transient browser localStorage history without separating durable gate verdict records from heavy media.
src/components/app/modules/DistributionModule.tsx:176 Attribution is limited to marketing channel click shares rather than beat-to-source evidence shares with a sum-to-runtime invariant.
src/components/ai/ContentBriefGenerator.tsx:331 Automated SEO scoring provides advisory hint chips without carrying concrete repair text or fixes to an automated revision stage.
src/components/ai/ContentBriefGenerator.tsx:524 Grounding keywords enter generation without a follow-up interrogation queue that can kill, downgrade, or retract evidence facts.

pairs.registryProposal: The standard assumes review iteration loops are implemented primarily for timeline-based continuous or discrete media (beats, seconds, audio seams); web text content engines (articles, outlines, briefs) require explicit adaptation guidelines for hierarchical block-structured text where operations map to document blocks rather than timeline seconds.
